notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. Staged only into the verifier image and never on the agent surface. It is a BAR and not a claim to be the optimum of this space: it is the best initialisation an authoring search over this harness found. Two findings define it. The first is that a single conventional scale of 0.02 applied to every role recovers most of the framework default's deficit, and that every role-wise refinement of it that a practitioner would reach for first -- a hotter embedding, a colder head, a zeroed head -- makes things worse rather than better. The second is that the one refinement that does pay is a residual taper on the two projections that write into the residual stream, at a divisor of 2.5 rather than the textbook 1/sqrt(2*6) of 3.46, which overshoots and gives 0.028 nats back.
